items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: we know the band could play by the table at school

ctx.x: Well, I don't know, over the way I got it at, but I'll tell you the truth.

Years ago, a long time ago, we couldn't play nothing but that for the boys. Like we had our boy here at Simon J. Peterson's school up there, and we know the band could play by the table at school. You see, on a certain reason, just on that part, they thought it was so fine, they gritted, and men of them were liking it.
It's a special chorus. I know George Lewis plays it, Piku played it, Burbank played it. I believe Big R. Louis. Well you told me once, Mealy, or am I wrong, that you heard it from Big R. Louis.
